2:197.text: so whoever has made ḥajj obligatory upon himself therein

no sexual relations and no disobedience and no disputing during ḥajj. And whatever good you do - Allāh knows it. And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is fear of Allāh. And fear Me, O you of understanding.

2:198.text: There is no blame upon you for seeking bounty
. But when you depart from ʿArafāt, remember Allāh at al-Mashʿar al-Ḥarām.
And remember Him, as He has guided you, for indeed, you were before that among those astray.

2:199.text: Then depart from the place from where
the people depart and ask forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

2:200.text: And when you have completed your rites, remember Allāh like your
remembrance of your fathers or with
greater remembrance. And among the people is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world," and he will have in the Hereafter no share.

2:201.text: But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world
good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

2:202.text: Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allāh is swift in account.
